# Instructions for ui.frontend

This module contains general frontend code integrated with AEM.

## Guidance
- Follow patterns already used in this module.
- Keep components and utilities modular and readable.
- Preserve existing integration with AEM-rendered markup and clientlibs.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies and broad rewrites.
- Prefer the smallest safe change.

## Quality
- Avoid dead code and monolithic functions.
- Prefer clear naming and low-complexity logic.
- Consider maintainability and SonarCloud-style concerns.

## Output expectations
- Explain integration impact with AEM markup or clientlibs when relevant.
